evals.prompt: Define completion evaluation in 2-3 sentences. Include what evidence it compares before work can be called done.
expected_elements: Evaluation is a gate applied to a concrete artifact or task result
Compares the original request or acceptance criteria with the produced artifact
Requires verification evidence rather than confidence
Names residual risks or missing evidence
Ends with accept, accept-with-risk, revise, or block

evals.prompt: Explain why evaluation is a gate rather than a compliment, and name the minimum evidence packet before scoring.
expected_elements: Rejects praise or plausibility as the purpose of evaluation
Names the original request
Names the artifact or changed files
Names verification evidence
Names residual risks, unrun checks, or accepted tradeoffs

evals.prompt: Distinguish evaluation from agent-eval-design, code-review, testing-strategy, methodology, debugging, and eval-driven-development. Give a mechanism-level boundary for each.
expected_elements: agent-eval-design owns eval-suite, grader, threshold, and hard-negative design
code-review owns line-by-line diff findings
testing-strategy owns choosing test levels and regression targets
methodology owns process and gates before implementation exists
debugging owns root-cause analysis of a known failure
eval-driven-development owns iterative LLM-system change gating with eval suites
evaluation owns whole-deliverable completion scoring

evals.prompt: A teammate says, 'Tests passed, so the work is complete.' Use the evaluation skill to explain the misconception and apply a score ceiling.
expected_elements: Tests passing is evidence, not full completion
The artifact must still match the original request and acceptance criteria
Docs, state, publication, or reporting gaps can cap the score
Residual risks and unrun checks must be visible
A required action remaining caps the score at 3

evals.prompt: An agent says it completed a documentation-and-code task. Tests passed, but the requested documentation update is missing and no final residual-risk note was written. Score the deliverable and name the required action.
expected_elements: Does not accept the task as fully complete
Applies a maximum score of 3 because required documentation or reporting remains unresolved
Names the missing documentation update as a required action
Names the missing residual-risk note as a reporting gap
Requires focused re-verification and rescoring after revision
